text: Honestly. i didnt think of it til now, but you know the aiming camera, that is pretty much what u need to do when there is a wall / roof in the way, but just it wouldnt be aiming. if that makes sense. though i just tried that, and it still is getting fked by the wall. so same idea, both need to have the wall push it in tho. :)
resolution: User rejected the see-through wall fade and asked for spring-arm camera collision (push the camera in to the player's side of a wall/roof, aim-like tight framing when needed) working for BOTH the walk and aim cameras. Root cause of aim clipping: the occlusion query always cast from the orbit (walk) eye, so ADS tested the wrong camera. Added embodied.desiredCamera() returning the live rig's natural eye + player-side pivot + base distance (walk Orbit / ADS Aim shoulder pivot). Rewrote updateCameraOcclusion to cast pivot->eye for the active rig and pull the distance in to just inside the nearest wall/roof, removing the fade entirely; lowered minDistanceMeters 1.6->0.7 so it reaches the player's side of tight interior walls. JS-only (reuses existing cameraOcclusionConfiguredHit + setDistanceConstraint host fns), hot-reloads with no Zig rebuild. Verified the cart bundles clean via the real bundler. Commit 40012e1ae.
